gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all status categories in Jira so that I can understand the different stages of my project's workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all status categories, including their IDs and names, allowing me to categorize issues effectively.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get details of a specific status category by its ID or key to ensure I am using the correct category in my API calls.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified status category, including its name and description, so I can confirm its attributes.
